items.title: 32.12 Industrial Chemical Processes (industry ke chemical processes) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.12, printed pages 239-240 (PDF 242-243). The process equations, Solvay flow and membrane-cell diagrams are our aids.

blocks.text: Chemical manufacturing do bare pillars (sutoonon) par khari hai: reaction engineering (reactions ko bare level par chalana) aur separation technology (cheezon ko alag karne ki technology). Industry mein kai ahem chemical processes istemal hote hain. In mein se kuch yeh hain:

items: Polymerisation: Is process mein monomers kehlane wale chhote molecules aapas mein jur kar polymers kehlane wali lambi chains (zanjeerein) banate hain. Addition polymerisation mein monomers koi atom khoye baghair aik doosre se jurte hain (maslan ethylene monomers se polyethene). Condensation polymerisation mein monomers jurte waqt aik chhota molecule, aam taur par paani, chhorte hain (maslan monomers se polyesters). Engro Polymer and Chemicals Pakistan mein Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) banane wali sole (akeli) company hai.

Refining aur Reforming: Refining mein fractional distillation crude oil ko boiling points ke farq se mukhtalif cheezon mein alag karti hai. Sab se ahem fractions (hisse) gasoline (petrol), diesel, kerosene (mitti ka tel) waghera hain. Reforming straight chain (seedhi zanjeer) wale hydrocarbons ko branched (shaakhon wale) hydrocarbons mein badalna hai taake fuel ki quality (mayaar) behtar ho. Catalytic reforming mein hydrocarbons ko catalyst ke saath garam kar ke zyada octane number wali gasoline banayi jaati hai. Aksar isay “Oil and Gas” mein gina jata hai, magar PARCO aur Attock Refinery jaisi refineries mein cracking aur reforming poori chemical industry ko zaroori petrochemical feedstocks (kaccha maal) deti hain.

Haber-Bosch Process: Haber process mein nitrogen (N₂) aur hydrogen (H₂) gases se ammonia (NH₃) gas banayi jaati hai. Is mein iron (loha) ke crystals catalyst ka kaam karte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq zameen par hone wali nitrogen fixation ka 13% isi process se hota hai, kyunke 70% ammonia seedha khaad banane mein lagti hai. Engro Fertilizers aur FFC jaise bare plants natural gas ko feedstock bana kar ammonia banate hain, jo phir urea mein badli jaati hai.

Contact Process: Is process mein V₂O₅ ya Pt catalyst ki madad se sulphur dioxide (SO₂) gas ko sulphur trioxide (SO₃) gas mein badla jata hai. Phir SO₃ se oleum banta hai, aur aakhir mein oleum sulphuric acid mein badal jata hai. Is process se bohat pure (khalis) aur concentrated (garha) H₂SO₄ milta hai. Sulphuric acid duniya mein sab se zyada istemal hone wala chemical hai, is liye ise aksar “King of Chemicals” (chemicals ka badshah) kehte hain. Pakistan mein kai plants contact process chalate hain, maslan Nimir Industrial Chemicals.

Solvay Process: Solvay process brine (namak ka garha solution) aur limestone se sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) banata hai. Brine mein ammonia dali jaati hai aur us mein se carbon dioxide guzari jaati hai, jis se sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) ka precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) banta hai. Garam karne par yeh sodium carbonate ban jata hai. Calcium carbonate ke decomposition (toot) se mile lime (choona) se ammonia regenerate (dobara hasil) kar li jaati hai. By-product (saath mein banne wali cheez) calcium chloride (CaCl₂) hai. Lucky Core Industries (pehle ICI) glass (sheesha), detergent aur paper (kaghaz) industries ke liye soda ash banati hai.

Chlor-Alkali Process: Chlor-alkali process aik industrial electrolysis (bijli guzaar kar compound torna) ka tareeqa hai jo sodium chloride (NaCl) ki brine ko tor kar teen ahem chemicals banata hai: chlorine (Cl₂), sodium hydroxide (NaOH, yani caustic soda) aur hydrogen (H₂). Yeh plastics, detergents aur paani saaf karne ki cheezein banane ke liye zaroori hai, aur aam taur par high efficiency aur purity (khalis product) ke liye modern membrane cell technology use karta hai. Is sector mein Sitara Chemical Industries aur Ittehad Chemicals primary players (bari companies) hain, jo textile aur water treatment (paani saaf karne ke) sectors ko support karti hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab in processes ko sirf alfaaz mein batati hai. Samajhne ke liye in ki equations yeh hain (yeh hamari taraf se hain):

blocks.latex: \ce{NaCl + NH3 + CO2 + H2O -> NaHCO3 v + NH4Cl}
blocks.text_alt: NaCl + NH₃ + CO₂ + H₂O → NaHCO₃↓ + NH₄Cl (Solvay)

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qataar: brine (NaCl) + NH3 -> carbonating tower -> solid NaHCO3 -> heat NaHCO3 -> Na2CO3 (soda ash). Garam kiya gaya limestone CO2 tower ko aur CaO recovery khane ko deta hai; NaHCO3 se bacha NH4Cl solution (dashed) recovery khane mein jata hai: CaO + NH4Cl -> NH3 + CaCl2. NH3 wapas brine mein, aur CaCl2 by-product.
blocks.caption: Solvay process ka flow chart (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar ki line main raasta hai: brine mein NH₃ milao, carbonating tower mein CO₂ guzaro, NaHCO₃ ka solid alag karo aur garam kar ke Na₂CO₃ (soda ash) banao. Limestone garam karne se CO₂ tower ke liye aur CaO recovery ke liye milta hai. Recovery khane mein NH₄Cl aur CaO se NH₃ wapas banti hai (dobara istemal) aur CaCl₂ by-product bachta hai.

blocks.alt: Membrane cell: baen taraf anode (+) brine (NaCl solution) mein, Cl2 oopar nikalti, 2Cl- -> Cl2 + 2e-. Beech mein ion-exchange membrane jis se Na+ daen jata hai. Daen taraf cathode (-) NaOH solution mein, H2 oopar nikalti, 2H2O + 2e- -> H2 + 2OH-. Neeche: 2NaCl + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2.
blocks.caption: Chlor-alkali membrane cell (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Brine anode wale hisse mein hai: wahan Cl⁻ ions electrons de kar Cl₂ gas bante hain. Na⁺ ions membrane se guzar kar cathode ki taraf jaate hain, jahan paani se H₂ gas aur OH⁻ ions bante hain. Na⁺ aur OH⁻ mil kar NaOH dete hain. Membrane Cl₂ aur NaOH ko milne nahi deti, is liye products khalis rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: (a) Haber-Bosch process aur (b) contact process mein kaun sa catalyst use hota hai?
Chlor-alkali process ki teen products kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine (Cl₂), sodium hydroxide (NaOH, caustic soda) aur hydrogen (H₂).

items: Polymerisation: addition (polyethene) aur condensation (polyesters, paani nikalta hai).
Refining: fractional distillation; reforming: seedhi zanjeer se branched, zyada octane.
Haber-Bosch: N₂ + H₂ se NH₃ (iron catalyst); contact: SO₂ → SO₃ (V₂O₅/Pt) → oleum → H₂SO₄.
Solvay: brine + limestone se Na₂CO₃ (by-product CaCl₂); chlor-alkali: Cl₂, NaOH, H₂.
